title: Single log line is 49KB+ (ext4) / 110KB+ (btrfs) of systemd-journald disk writes
summary: This content discusses a systemd-journald issue where a single log line can cause excessive disk writes (49KB+ on ext4, 110KB+ on btrfs) due to journal file fragmentation and metadata overhead. It highlights a performance and storage efficiency problem in systemd's logging subsystem, with community discussion on workarounds and potential fixes.
